summary: No findings. Fairness (REQ-025): Table.tsx renders only the user's own hole cards (players.find(seat === USER_SEAT)), hand.board (which holds only dealt community cards; the deck stays in HandState.deck) and public data attributes (data-street, data-to-act, data-action-count, data-seat, data-card on visible cards only). Bot hole cards, the deck and the replay code live only in React state, which spec section 8 accepts. Bots act through actWith, which passes the policy only playerView(state, toAct). The shipped app takes its replay code from newReplayCode (crypto.getRandomValues, all-zero rejected), the default for useTableSession, and App passes no newCode override. A production build (vite build into a scratch outDir) has exactly one getRandomValues call site and no harness or stub code: 'Table harness', stubReplayWords, TlhTableHarness and the array.set override all appear 0 times. The harness files live under e2e/support and nothing in src imports them. The only user input path is the action buttons: each one passes a legalActions() result into act(), which re-checks nextStep === 'user', and applyUserAction/applyAction validate again. There is no text input, URL parameter, storage or network. No new dependencies, secrets or logging.
